PresenterIntent: Convert stateful and temporal facts into ordered lifecycle display data.
RecognizerIntent: Treat lifecycle controls as navigation or inspection unless an explicit mutating action is selected.
LoweringRationale: Lifecycle progress has enough structure to deserve a presentation type: current state, phase ordering, temporal hints, and navigation/inspection actions. Street Deli order tracking is the first concrete dogfooding case. The v1 rule intentionally matches the more common `state_indicator` obligation rather than requiring the narrower `order_lifecycle_progress` obligation, because current Street Deli semantic data exposes state for orders and prep entities even when temporal lifecycle projections are not yet complete.
